Huh... 🤔 I think this might be interesting. To apply the immortal position on Sakuya herself. Can you imagine the idea of this chrono-abomination actually outliving everybody else?

Actually, what if Sakuya will **regenerate** eventually? She's not Lunarian at all! She's Gallifreyan! Remilia! You made a Time Lord your chief maid?!
